node.about: Runs a program of your own on what arrives.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.about: How long it is given before it is a failure.

attributes.name: restart
attributes.about: Whether it is started again when it stops: true or false.

attributes.name: type-in
attributes.about: The value type it is handed: kelvin, volt, ampere, watt, metre, metre_per_second, newton, kilogram_per_second or ratio.

attributes.name: type-out
attributes.about: The value type its answers are, as type-in lists them.
